## Change and reason

Describe scope and user-visible behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] Portable tests and repository privacy checks pass.
- [ ] Relevant native MySQL tests ran, or the reason for skipping is stated.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No data, credentials, real IPs, personal emails or private logs are included.
- [ ] Recovery/rollback and resource impact have been considered.

Use synthetic examples. Report security vulnerabilities privately (see SECURITY.md).
